transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well... I suppose it's my sleep. It's become completely unmoored lately. 

At first, I was waking up after just two or three hours... drafting plans, feeling ready to go. But now... I don't know. I just lie awake before dawn. My stomach gets tight. There's just... no sense of rest anymore.
During those nights when you slept only two or three hours and still felt ready to go, did you also feel unusually upbeat or energized?

I suppose I did. For a few weeks, I felt... quite optimistic, actually. Any obstacles just seemed trivial. 

But... well, if anyone questioned what I was doing, I didn't have much patience for it. I snapped at them. It just felt like they were trying to sabotage me, when I was the only sensible man in the room. That's all.
During that period, did you feel more important, powerful, or capable than usual?

I... suppose you could say that. Yes. I just felt very capable. 

I... well, I truly believed I was going to single-handedly repair my retirement accounts. I thought I could advise three different start-ups, and... I had this whole plan to turn the local arts council into some sort of regional powerhouse. 

It's uncomfortable to admit now, but... at the time, it just seemed like my judgment was suddenly superior to everyone else's. That's all.
During that time, did you hear or see things that other people could not?
No. I... no, nothing like that. I didn't see or hear anything that wasn't there.
During that energized period, did you ever become absolutely convinced of something others said was impossible or untrue?
I don't... no. I don't think so. I just had my plans. They weren't impossible, just ambitious. People just didn't see the vision, that's all.
During that energized period, did your behavior cause serious problems in your life, such as at work, with money, or in your relationships?

Yes. It... it caused problems. 

My wife, she... well, she handles the accounts now. All the finances. And she feels she needs to stay close by, just to make sure I'm... safe, I suppose. 

And the museum, the arts council... I just stopped going. I wasn't reliable anymore. Same with my friends. I just... I haven't been around.
